methodology_other: The algorithm used to produce this dataset first identifies the clusters of geographic cells with the largest population counts within the region. It then assigns a point to each cluster, and uses these points to generate catchment areas for each of these settlements. The catchment area generation algorithm assigns each block of land to the "closest" settlement. In this context, "closest" refers to the shortest walking time between two points, taking into account land cover, topography, etc.
name: pakistan-settlement-catchment-areas
notes: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Pakistan with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.

organization.name: crosscut
organization.title: Crosscut
organization.description: Public health institutions in many low- and middle-income countries are awash in data for the first time in history. However, much of the value of this data has not yet been fully realized. This leads to more costly, less effective health programs. Crosscut is a U.S.-based consultancy and technology company that seeks to give Global Health programs an easy way to use complex data to solve specific problems. Our vision is to unlock complex data for Global Health programs to make operations more efficient and effective.
